question: 订单总数。
referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: 统计各订单状态的订单数量。
referenceSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: 统计各省用户数量。
referenceSql: SELECT province, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY province

question: 查询价格最高的5个在售商品，返回商品名称和价格。
referenceSql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY price DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5

question: 统计各店铺已完成订单销售额。
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM shops s JOIN orders o ON o.shop_id = s.id WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY s.id, s.name

question: 查询已完成订单销售额最高的10个商品。
referenceSql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, p.id ASC LIMIT 10

question: 统计各省用户已完成订单的平均客单价，保留两位小数。
referenceSql: SELECT u.province, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY u.province

question: 统计各商品分类的已完成销售额。
referenceSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.amount) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY p.category

question: 查询已完成消费金额最高的5位用户。
referenceSql: SELECT u.username, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY u.id, u.username ORDER BY spend DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 5

question: 统计各店铺的商品数量，包括没有商品的店铺。
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(p.id) FROM shops s LEFT JOIN products p ON p.shop_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name

question: 统计2026-08-01至2026-08-12每天的已完成订单量，按日期升序。
referenceSql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS order_date, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND created_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-08-13 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY order_date

question: 对比2026年7月和8月的已完成订单量，按月份升序。
referenceSql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month_value, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND created_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month_value

question: 截至2026-08-12，统计最近30天已完成订单销售额。
referenceSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND created_at >= '2026-07-14 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-08-13 00:00:00'

question: 统计各店铺2026年6月至8月的已完成订单月度销售趋势，按店铺ID和月份升序。
referenceSql: SELECT o.shop_id, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month_value, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.created_at >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND o.created_at < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY o.shop_id, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY o.shop_id, month_value

question: 查询订单总金额与订单明细金额合计不一致的订单。
referenceSql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS item_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) x ON x.order_id = o.id WHERE o.total_amount <> x.item_total

question: 查询从未产生订单明细的商品。
referenceSql: SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL

question: 统计各店铺退款率，返回百分比并保留两位小数。
referenceSql: SELECT s.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.id), 2) FROM shops s JOIN orders o ON o.shop_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name
